core_rules: NEVER modify any business logic, API calls, state management, routing or component props.
ONLY modify classes, HTML wrappers, and CSS/Tailwind configs.
Ensure ALL interactive elements retain or gain a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

shadows_and_radii.radius: rounded-2xl (1rem) for main cards, rounded-xl (0.75rem) for inner elements like buttons/inputs

sidebar.container: w-64 bg-[#FAFAFA] border-r border-slate-200/70 flex flex-col py-6 px-4 shrink-0 h-screen sticky top-0
sidebar.link_default: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100/80 hover:text-slate-900 transition-all duration-200
sidebar.link_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] border border-slate-200/50 text-blue-600

page_header.title: text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
page_header.breadcrumb: text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2

dashboard_cards.wrapper: bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/70 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] transition-all duration-300 ease-out flex flex-col gap-3
dashboard_cards.title: text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500
dashboard_cards.icon_wrapper: w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-600 border border-slate-100

recharts.tooltip: contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#fff', borderRadius: '12px', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)', padding: '12px', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: '500' }}

tables_and_lists.wrapper: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/70 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] overflow-hidden
tables_and_lists.header: bg-slate-50/50 border-b border-slate-200/70 text-slate-500 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 shadow-sm transition-all rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold

testing.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs) MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Start by updating /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided --radius and css_variables_for_index_css exactly.
2. Update /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js to include font family 'Manrope' under theme.extend.fontFamily.sans.
3. Restructure /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js to use the premium Vercel/Linear style sidebar guidelines (hover states, rounded-xl links, spacing).
4. Apply the 'dashboard_cards' and 'page_header' classes to the corresponding components in /app/frontend/src/pages/.
5. For charts (Recharts), apply smooth monotone lines, hidden vertical grids, and the custom rounded tooltip style.
6. Apply the 'tables_and_lists' styles to any data tables in products, raw materials, etc.
7. CRITICAL: Do NOT alter any functionality, hooks, fetch calls, logic, or database structures.
8. Check all interactive components to ensure data-testid is present.
